name.baseName: Burning of 1 g diesel in locomotive with particle filter (93%)

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Average technology

# Included processes
The inventory includes the emissions of burning 1 gram of diesel in a locomotive. It is assumed that 93% of the locomotives have a particle filter; Geography: Switzerland
